counters.notes: Provisional, low confidence: related JKR-led 3v3 report, not this Depa-first defence. Test Fear on Depa and removing JKR; he can save other Jedi but not himself here. Depa heals on debuffs. Opening speed, mods, relics and datacrons unknown. Uses Malak and a Sith Empire core.

Depa healing, timeout and early Nihilus death are risks. Datacrons, mods and relics unknown. Uses Traya/Savage.

counters.notes: Provisional, low confidence: one exact-lineup report, both clones lost. Not a dependable win or high-banner promise. Test GAS protection and survival through opening burst and the post-clone transition. Battle date, attempt state, omicrons, datacrons, mods and relics unknown. Uses 501st; conserves a GL.

Provisional, low confidence: same defending members under Malgus lead only. SEE leader with Wat; third slot intentionally empty. Test shield tech, Link and survival to ultimate under DR Ferocity/speed. Do not inherit Malgus-lead rates or omit his nonleader abilities. Ultimate and Wat bonus-turn upgrade required for this test. Datacrons, defensive omicrons, mods and relics unknown. Uses SEE/Wat; preserves Bane.

Provisional, low confidence: same members under Malgus lead only. Test Daka/Zombie survival and revive cycle while SLKR scales to ultimate. DR lead, nonleader Malgus abilities and datacrons may disrupt the route. Required support upgrades, mods and relics must be checked before trying. Uses a GL and splits Nightsisters. No inherited win rate.

Provisional reserve alternative, low confidence: mixed related Malgus-led reports, not exact DR-led proof. Check DR speed/control and JKL route before trying. Omicrons, datacrons, mods and relics unknown. Consumes a GL and premium Jedi; lower research priority than the preceding options.
